exposure: gestational age of prior preterm births
type of prior preterm births (spontaneous or indicated)
outcome: preterm birth (<37 weeks) in the third delivery
cohort: The study included 4472 women who had three consecutive singleton births at a single medical center over a 20-year period (1994-2013).
finding: The risk of preterm birth in the third delivery significantly increased with the number and order of prior preterm births, ranging from 3.5% in women with no prior PTBs to 56.5% in women with two prior PTBs.
gest_age: Outcome defined as preterm birth <37 weeks; exposure involved gestational age of prior preterm births.
